title: DNA Extraction Using Phenol-Chloroform
author: Santiago Montero-Mendieta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q2cdyaw

steps.title: Add Laird's buffer and tissue
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Laird’s buffer to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube (one tube per sample). Cut 10–30 µg muscle tissue and place it into the tube containing the buffer.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl Proteinase K (20 mg ml⁻¹) to each tube. Incubate with gentle mixing at 56 °C overnight (minimum 4 h). If the tissue is not fully lysed, add additional Proteinase K and extend the incubation.

steps.title: Phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl phenol to each tube, shake vigorously for 10 min, then centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm. Transfer the entire aqueous supernatant to a new 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl (PCI) to the tube, shake vigorously for 10 min, centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm, and transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl chloroform‑isoamyl to the tube, shake vigorously for 10 min, centrifuge 10 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm, and transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube, avoiding any interphase material.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with NaAc and ethanol
steps.instruction: To the collected supernatant, add 0.1 vol of 3 M sodium acetate (e.g., 40 µl to 400 µl supernatant) and mix gently (no vortex). Then add 2 vol of ice‑cold 95–100 % ethanol (pre‑chilled at –20 °C; e.g., 800 µl to 400 µl supernatant), invert tubes to mix. Incubate at –20 °C overnight (minimum 5–6 h).

steps.title: Ethanol wash and pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 30 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm. Discard the supernatant. Add 1000 µl ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm, and discard the supernatant. Centrifuge 5 min at 4 °C, 13 000 rpm, discard residual ethanol. Air‑dry the pellet at room temperature until completely dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried DNA pellet in 100 µl ddH₂O.
